properties.bedrock: Gullane Formation (Carboniferous sedimentary sandstone, siltstone, and mudstone sequence)
properties.superficial_deposits: Glacial Till (Devensian diamicton) overlying carved post-glacial incised valley of the Water of Leith
properties.topography: Steep north-northwest descending terrace dropping towards the Stockbridge gorge basin; pronounced topographical relief along Kerr Street and Gloucester Lane
properties.hydrology: Water of Leith riparian corridor drainage catchment, high permeability in fractured sandstone beneath dense urban macadam and historic sett paving

properties.neighborhood_context: Stockbridge / New Town Western Extension transition, characterized by Georgian neoclassical tenement blocks, Victorian institutional infill, and Scots Baronial detailing

structures.name: Gloucester Street / Kerr Street Corner Baronial Villa & Clock Tower (Forefront)

materials.facade: Cream-buff Craigleith/Hailes ashlar sandstone with pronounced rustication, corbelled corner turret (tourelle) with conical slate spire
materials.roof: Scottish Ballachulish grey-blue slate, lead flashing, decorative parapet
materials.fenestration: Timber sash-and-case windows with ashlar surrounds, oriel bay projection

structures.name: Stockbridge Parish Church (St Stephen's Comely Bank Church) Spire

materials.facade: Dressed polished sandstone masonry, lancet louvres, buttressed belfry
materials.roof: Broach stone spire terminating in weather vane

structures.name: Kerr Street / North West Circus Place Georgian Tenement Terraces (Flanking Left & Right)

materials.facade: Smooth ashlar Craigleith sandstone, cast-iron balconettes, platbands, rusticated ground floors with timber shopfronts
materials.roof: Mansard and pitched slate roofs with substantial stone chimney stacks and terracotta pots

structures.name: Gloucester Lane Mews & Low-Rise Modern Infill (Midground Right)

materials.facade: Rubble sandstone with painted harling and modern buff brick accents
materials.roof: Pitched slate and standing-seam zinc profiles

ground_plane.roadway: Asphalt carriageway over historic whinstone setts, thermoplastic yellow box junction and cycling lane markings
ground_plane.pavements: Caithness stone flagstones and granite kerb stones
